caption: Read a cell as A → α: the row gives A, the column gives the lookahead a, and the cell holds α. So M[E,id] = E → T E′ is the very first move of the trace, and the ε entries, placed under the tokens that can follow their nonterminal, bring the count to 13 filled cells with no conflict.

spec.title: LL(1) table M: row A, column a
spec.aria: A five-row table for the expression grammar with rows E, E′, T, T′ and F and columns id, +, *, (, ) and $; each filled cell gives the right side of the production to apply, with E → T E′ at M[E,id] and the ε entries under the follow tokens.
